title: UAAP: UP completes come-from-behind win vs. Adamson U for share of lead
summary: University of the Philippines erased a 13-point deficit to overcome Adamson University in UAAP Season 89 men's basketball on Wednesday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
